(B) Client establishes a TCP three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) with the web server on destination port 443
(C) Client and server perform a TLS/SSL cryptographic handshake to negotiate encryption keys
(D) Browser transmits an encrypted HTTPS GET request, and the server returns the requested HTML document

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Web request cascade: DNS lookup -> TCP handshake -> TLS encryption handshake -> HTTPS GET request and response.
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
